records.name: baViewRepresents
records.rationale: BA view topics include organizations, activities, capabilities, governance, partnerships and offerings; no shared target class has been justified.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A BA view explicitly references an organization and an activity as separate topics.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer that a view target acquires a new identity or that core depends on the optional BA module.
records.remaining_evidence: Define a documented target family or qualified topic links if cross-family query need is approved.

records.name: capacityBearer
records.rationale: SupplyCapacity is a Mode; current Mode→unspecified bearer direction cannot be labelled characterization directly. W4 permits Organization or Facility, which have different Kind identities.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: An evidenced capacity instance inheres in exactly one organization or facility at a time.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer capacity from an aggregate observation or assign the same intrinsic Mode to two different bearer individuals.
records.remaining_evidence: Choose explicit inverse bearer→Mode characterization or scoped bearer roles; justify minimum/maximum and optional possession.

records.name: disruptionAffects
records.rationale: W4 allows affected facility, activity, dependency or availability context; the typed SupplyDependency child is narrower than the parent.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: An evidenced disruption affects a specific dependency in a dated episode.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A co-reported shortage alone cannot establish a causal disruption or its target.
records.remaining_evidence: Specify admitted target families and causal evidence before general OWL range or stereotype.

records.name: hasActiveSubstance
records.rationale: W4 mentions Product or Presentation; W6 maps medicinal_product.primary_substance_id as a bounded primary-substance hook, not a universal ontology domain.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A medicinal product with a source-backed primary substance identifier maps to that substance.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer that a presentation using the parent relation is a MedicinalProduct; these Kinds are disjoint.
records.remaining_evidence: Keep parent domain open; test separate Product and Presentation scoped patterns and composition cardinalities.

records.name: locatedIn
records.rationale: W4 and W6 give Facility→GeographicFeature and facility.geography_id, but the generic parent is not proven Facility-only for every future source.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A facility has a source-backed physical location feature.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An organization's headquarters or a jurisdiction label must not be typed Facility via a global domain axiom.
records.remaining_evidence: Preserve generic parent until all locatable entity families reviewed; use a scoped facility location contract.

records.name: matchObject
records.rationale: W6 entity-resolution assertions compare two source-record references and retain a canonical matched entity type/identifier; target representation and entity must not be conflated.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: An assertion records two source records, matched entity type, method and status.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An ambiguous record pair is not an accepted real-world identity equality.
records.remaining_evidence: Define whether subject/object are SourceRecord or a typed union, symmetrical admissibility, cardinality and identity constraints.

records.name: matchSubject
records.rationale: W6 represents two source-record references for an assertion; fixing one endpoint to Product or Presentation would exclude other match domains.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: An assertion identifies its first source record with provenance.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A source identifier alone is not universal canonical entity identity.
records.remaining_evidence: Define a common endpoint policy with matchObject, disjoint source-vs-entity layers and acceptable null/ambiguous status.

records.name: observationResultAbout
records.rationale: W4 results can be about products, presentations, supply capacity or other contexts; G2 introduced scoped product and presentation children.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A source observation names a specific product or presentation as its subject.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An aggregate result does not create a patient individual, and a product link does not identify a presentation.
records.remaining_evidence: Test all result subfamilies before a common range; preserve child target distinctions and resolve aboutness truthmaker.

records.name: riskAssessmentConcerns
records.rationale: A risk assessment may concern dependencies, vulnerabilities and other conditions; AssetAtRisk was explicitly deferred from the active G1 import.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: An assessment evaluates cited evidence about a supply dependency.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Mentioning an asset does not prove a vulnerability or quantified risk.
records.remaining_evidence: Admit target families with assessment evidence; do not impose a deferred AssetAtRisk range.

records.name: riskTreatmentAddresses
records.rationale: The extension has RiskTreatmentActivity and RiskTreatmentPlan but no settled common target among risk, vulnerability, asset or consequence.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A treatment activity explicitly addresses a documented, identified target under a plan.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not claim that every treatment is effective, or that a target is necessarily a SupplyDependency.
records.remaining_evidence: Define treatment plan/target semantics, evidence and direction before adding range or stereotype.

records.name: usedSourceArtifact
records.rationale: W3/W6 separate datasets, releases, source records, documents and transformation inputs; DataSourceResource is not shown to subsume them all.
records.positive_synthetic_illustration: A transformation activity uses an identified source record with release and fingerprint.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A dataset name alone cannot fabricate a source record or complete provenance chain.
records.remaining_evidence: Specify the admitted source-artifact abstraction or scoped subproperties for record/release/document; check PROV alignment.
